title: 第1章  天很热心很凉，恶客上门！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

清溪村。

午后空气都是热的，宋青山此时却浑身冰凉

心更凉！

僵硬扭动脖子，转头四顾。

床上地面，散落着性感的黑色蕾丝贴身衣物，还有一些纸巾。

就连他的脖子上，都挂着一条薄如蝉翼的黑色丝袜。

“这玩的也太花了。”

宋青山将丝袜扯下，看向身旁。

丝绒凉被下，正露出一抹雪腻圆润的香肩，乌黑长发如瀑布般散落在枕头上，半遮住那张冷艳绝美的脸颊。

村长周有田的绝美娇妻，也是这十里八乡最负盛名的村医。

“不是做梦……”

宋青山目光呆滞，狠狠捏了一把自己大腿后，这才接受这个现实，心中顿时慌得不行。

村长周有田，那可是清溪村土皇帝！

别看平时骑个二八大杠，谁不知道那家里还有一辆大奔驰。

有钱又有权！

虽说他一个大小伙子不至于怕了对方，可他还包了村里池塘养鱼呢。

今天宋青山来村长家，就是来找村长池塘续租。

结果周有田不在，他反倒被苏韵给拉进屋给办了！

这事儿要是漏了风，别说池塘续租彻底没戏，周有田非得扒了他的皮不可！

而苏韵。

听说以前是大医院的医生，有颜有能力，妥妥的白领精英。

后来家里遭了难急缺钱，在当时是病人的周有田猛烈金钱攻势下，这才下嫁到了清溪村。

在村民和宋青山眼里，苏韵和他们完全是两个世界的人。

苏韵永远穿着纤尘不染的白大褂，骨子里透着精英阶层的傲慢，看谁都带着疏离，村医工作其实也只是找个事情做。

但别看是白大褂。

在别人身上，那是肥大臃肿，裹在苏韵丰腴曼妙的身段上，就成了最致命的制服诱惑。

这导致村诊所的生意出奇的好！

村里男人隔两天就头疼脑热。

哪怕明知道去了后，会换来苏韵看狗一样的冷淡眼神，依旧乐此不疲地往诊所钻。

而这样一个仿佛高悬云端、不可亵玩的女神，刚刚竟然和他……

还那么疯狂！

“真是要命！”

想到这件事可能引起的后果，宋青山越来越不安，生怕下一秒周有田就推门回来。

他连忙起身，手忙脚乱地往腿上套裤子。

穿戴整齐，刚准备溜之大吉，背后忽地响起一道冷若冰霜的声音。

“站住！”

宋青山吓得浑身一哆嗦，本能地想拔腿就跑，可双腿却像灌了铅一样钉在原地。

尴尬转过头，对上苏韵喷火的美眸。

此时苏韵正紧紧攥着被角遮住胸口，柳眉因为身体痛楚而微微蹙起，但看向他的眼神，像是能杀人一样，

“苏医生……我……”

宋青山张张嘴，想要解释，却不知道说什么好。

虽说之前，对方拉他进屋的时候面色潮红、眼神迷离，状态明显不对，可这事也绝对怨不到他！

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Qingxi Village.

The air was hot in the afternoon, but Song Qingshan was cold all over at this time

My heart is even colder!

He twisted his neck stiffly and turned his head to look around.

Sexy black lace underwear and some tissues were scattered on the floor of the bed.

Even around his neck was a pair of thin black stockings.

"This is too much fun."

Song Qingshan pulled off his stockings and looked to his side.

Under the velvet quilt, a touch of rounded shoulders was exposed, and the long black hair was scattered on the pillow like a waterfall, half covering the cold and beautiful face.

The beautiful wife of village chief Zhou Youtian is also the most famous village doctor in these ten miles and eight towns.

"It's not a dream..."

Song Qingshan's eyes were dull, and after he squeezed his thigh hard, he accepted the reality, and he suddenly panicked.

The village chief Zhou Youtian is the local emperor of Qingxi Village!

Although he usually rides a big bar, who doesn't know that there is a big Mercedes-Benz at home.

Rich and powerful!

Although he is not afraid of the other party as a young man, he also hired the village pond to raise fish.

Today Song Qingshan came to the village chief's house to renew the lease of Pond.

As a result, Zhou Youtian was not here, but Su Yun dragged him into the house and did it!

If this matter leaks out, not to mention that there will be no chance of renewing the lease of the pond, Zhou Youtian will have to skin him!

And Su Yun.

I heard that he used to be a doctor in a big hospital. He was good-looking, capable, and a proper white-collar elite.

Later, the family encountered difficulties and was short of money. Zhou Youtian, who was a patient at the time, was fiercely aggressive with money, so she married into Qingxi Village.

In the eyes of the villagers and Song Qingshan, Su Yun and them were completely different worlds.

Su Yun always wears a spotless white coat, and she has the arrogance of the elite in her bones. She looks alienated from everyone, and her job as a village doctor is actually just something to do.

But don't look at it as a white coat.

On others, it would be fat and bloated, but wrapped around Su Yun's plump and graceful figure, it became the most deadly uniform temptation.

This resulted in surprisingly good business at the village clinic!

The men in the village suffer from headaches and fever every two days.

Even though he knew that after going there, he would get Su Yun's cold eyes like a dog, he still went to the clinic happily.

And such a goddess who seemed to be hanging high in the clouds and not to be played with, had just been with him...

So crazy!

"It's really fatal!"

Thinking of the possible consequences of this incident, Song Qingshan became more and more uneasy, fearing that Zhou Youtian would open the door and come back in the next second.

He stood up quickly and hurriedly put his pants on his legs.

Dressed neatly, and just about to run away, a frosty voice suddenly sounded from behind.

"Stop!"

Song Qingshan was so scared that he trembled all over and instinctively wanted to run away, but his legs were nailed to the spot as if they were filled with lead.

Embarrassed, he turned his head and met Su Yun's beautiful, fire-breathing eyes.

At this time, Su Yun was clutching the corner of the quilt tightly to cover her chest. Her eyebrows were slightly frowned due to the pain in her body, but she looked at him with eyes that could kill people.

"Doctor Su...I..."

Song Qingshan opened his mouth, wanting to explain, but he didn't know what to say.

Although before, when the other party pulled him into the house, his face was flushed, his eyes were blurred, and his state was obviously wrong, he definitely couldn't blame him for this!
